blocks.text: Business-plan software offers structured templates, financial modelling and guidance. To start a small online bookstore, tools such as PlanGuru or Enloop let you pick a retail template that guides you through sections like the overview and market analysis. Financial calculators take costs for inventory, website and marketing and produce projections of sales and cash flow with charts, making it easier to present to investors or apply for funding.
